reasons: CS4330 is required in semester 5, but CS4330 is offered only in Sem 2 (even semesters); semester 5 is an odd semester, so it cannot be placed there.

CS4330 also requires one of CS2220, LSM2104, LSM2241, or ZB2101, none of which you have completed; this prerequisite would need to be completed in a strictly earlier semester, which is impossible if CS4330 must be taken in semester 5.
